This file is for doing data import.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Import our first dataset.

```{r}
litters_df = 
  read_csv(
    file = "data/FAS_litters.csv",
    na = c("", "NA", ".")
  )

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```

Import our second dataset.

```{r}
pups_df = 
  read_csv(
    file = "data/FAS_pups.csv", 
    skip = 3,
    na = c("", "NA", ".")
  )

pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df)
```

## Look at data

```{r}
litters_df
pups_df
```

Head or tail

```{r}
head(litters_df,5)

tail(pups_df,5)
```

Skimming??

using"::" is to use one part of package instead of loading the entire package

```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df)
```
